notes: Challenge objects: things in the world that offer authored approaches, resolved with the one STA 2E task (src/rules/taskResolver.js). Framework = videogame adaptation; everything in 'maps' is TEST EPISODE CONTENT (Oct 2026), not book rules: the objects, their Difficulties, focus lists, equipment rules and outcomes are authoring choices to exercise the framework.

Designer decision (Oct 2026): exploration has no per-character action budget. In real time any party member in range may attempt any offered action as often as they like; only object state, requires, authored locks, complications and personal condition limit them. actionCost.exploration is metadata only. (Book: outside encounters there are no rounds or turns, p.250; group challenges p.268 and time pressure p.269 are optional tools, not used here.)
interactRange: how close (tiles, from the object's tile centre) a party member must stand to attempt or assist an action.

Object: id, name, type, position [x, y] (tile), state (starting state id), states { id: { label, description, tile } } where tile (optional) replaces the map tile at the object's position while in that state (e.g. a sealed door blocks the doorway); otherwise the map's own tile shows. covers (optional) [[x, y]]: more tiles the state's tile replaces (the second tile of a two-tile doorway).

Action: id, label, description; routine: true = simply works, no roll. task = { attribute, department, difficulty, focuses [exact focus names], tags [task tags for species abilities], complicationRange, equipment { label, tags, itemIds, without: 'impossible' | { difficulty }, bonus [{ label, tags, itemIds, difficulty }] }, talentIds, roleIds (talents / role benefits whose prose condition the author says this task meets), traitRules [{ trait, difficulty } | { trait, impossible: true }] }.

assist: the approaches a second party member may help with (each { label, attribute, department, focuses }); omitted = no assistance. requires: { states: [object states], flags: { flag: value }, conditions: [mission flag conditions, src/exploration/missionFlags.js] }; unmet = the action is not offered. Flags are the shared mission flags conversations and objectives use too; an objective's progress is the flag 'objective.{id}' ('active' | 'complete'). actionCost: { exploration, combat } metadata for later tactical use.

Outcomes: onSuccess, onFailure, onComplication (once if any complication remains after the roll, whether the task passed or failed), always. Effects: setState, setFlag { flag, value }, changeFlag { flag, op: 'set' | 'clear' | 'add', value }, noise { radius, intensity } (the NPC awareness noise event), revealNpcs { radius, source, identified } and addFact { id, text } (into Party Knowledge), adjustDifficulty { actionId (default: this action), change, label }, setNpcResponse { alertGroupId, from, to } (NPC reaction override), lock { seconds } (no retry until then; during combat, where the world clock stands still, no retry until the next combat round), message { text }, addLogEntry { text } (an entry in the Captain's Log, exploration/missionLog.js).

Scene traits (Book p.252, Create Trait p.289): addTrait { name, potency (default 1), description }, removeTrait { name }, changePotency { name, change } (a trait at Potency 0 is gone). The trait applies to any task (exploration or combat) whose traitRules name it. kind: 'createTrait' marks an action as Create Trait for the UI (Book: Difficulty 2, a contextual Attribute + Department). Which traits exist and where they can be created is authored (VIDEOGAME ADAPTATION: no free-text GM interface).

Deck 10 Brig (conversation validation encounter, Oct 2026, test content): the east section's two doorways are sealed bulkheads; the EPS Power Junction beside Lt. Okafor restores power. Talking to her (conversations/engineerSealedSection.json) can grant clearance (sectionAccessGranted: the bulkheads open normally) or diagnose the fault (faultDiagnosed: the junction offers the easier Replace the EPS Coupling instead of Restore Power). Without clearance the bulkheads need Override the Lockout once powered. Opening either bulkhead sets eastSectionOpen (the map's 'Get into the east section' objective reads it).

In combat (Book p.288): an action takes the action type in actionCost.combat (major or minor; a routine action without one is minor, any other action major), is attempted by the character whose turn it is, and is assisted by whoever set up an Assist for them or by the commander on a Direct (Control + Command), not by the assist approaches below.

offline.label: Offline
offline.description: The junction that feeds this section's grid. It is dark and smells of burnt insulation.

online.label: Online
online.description: The junction hums steadily; the section has power.

actions.label: Restore Power
actions.description: Trace the fault through the junction and bring the section's grid back up.

onSuccess.text: Lights flicker back on across the section.
We traced the fault through the EPS junction and brought the section's grid back online.

onFailure.text: The fault is buried somewhere in the junction; the grid stays dark.

onComplication.text: The junction arcs with a loud crack.

actions.label: Replace the EPS Coupling
actions.description: Lt. Okafor's diagnosis points straight at the burnt-out coupling. Swap it out.

onSuccess.text: The new coupling seats with a click and the section's lights come back on.
Following Lt. Okafor's diagnosis, we replaced the burnt-out EPS coupling. The section has power again.

onComplication.text: The junction arcs with a loud crack.

sealed.label: Sealed
sealed.description: The bulkhead to the east section sealed itself when the power failed. Without power it won't cycle.

actions.label: Open Bulkhead
actions.description: Lt. Okafor has cleared the party through; with power back the bulkhead cycles normally.

onSuccess.text: The bulkhead slides open.

actions.label: Override the Lockout
actions.description: Power is back but the lockout still holds. Bypass it without the engineer's clearance.

onSuccess.text: The lockout gives and the bulkhead slides open.

onComplication.text: A warning chime sounds from the bulkhead.

sealed.label: Sealed
sealed.description: The bulkhead to the east section sealed itself when the power failed. Without power it won't cycle.

actions.label: Open Bulkhead
actions.description: Lt. Okafor has cleared the party through; with power back the bulkhead cycles normally.

onSuccess.text: The bulkhead slides open.

actions.label: Override the Lockout
actions.description: Power is back but the lockout still holds. Bypass it without the engineer's clearance.

onSuccess.text: The lockout gives and the bulkhead slides open.

onComplication.text: A warning chime sounds from the bulkhead.

sealed.label: Sealed
sealed.description: The door is jammed shut and its control panel sparks fitfully.

forced.label: Forced open
forced.description: The door has been wrenched open; its frame is bent.

actions.label: Bypass Controls
actions.description: Splice past the damaged control circuit.

onSuccess.text: The door slides open.

onFailure.text: The circuit refuses to cooperate. Another attempt is possible.

onComplication.text: A power surge cracks loudly through the panel.

actions.label: Force the Door
actions.description: Brace and wrench the door open by hand.

onSuccess.text: The door grinds open.

onFailure.text: It won't budge yet. They need a moment before trying again.

actions.label: Open Door
actions.description: With power restored, the door opens normally.

onSuccess.text: The door slides open.

armed.label: Armed
armed.description: A security panel wired to the alarm the west guards use.

actions.label: Disable Alarm
actions.description: Cut the alarm circuit without tripping it.

onSuccess.text: The alarm circuit goes dead. The west guards can no longer raise the alarm.

onComplication.text: A warning chime sounds from the panel.

actions.label: Override Security Codes
actions.description: Work out the security codes and shut the alarm down from its own menu.

onSuccess.text: The alarm accepts the override and shuts down.

onComplication.text: A warning chime sounds from the panel.

idle.label: Idle
idle.description: An alien sensor console, still drawing power.

scanned.label: Sweep complete
scanned.description: The console shows the results of the last sweep.

actions.label: Run a Sensor Sweep
actions.description: Sweep the vault for life signs and anything unusual.

onSuccess.text: A hidden power conduit runs behind the north wall of the hall.
Life signs appear on the display, along with a power conduit behind the north wall.

onComplication.text: The console overloads; further sweeps will be harder.

actions.label: Identify Structural Weakness
actions.description: Scan the damaged door's frame for the point where it will give.

onSuccess.name: Structural Weakness
onSuccess.description: The damaged door's frame has a weak point (Force the Door: Difficulty -1).

onSuccess.text: The console highlights a fracture in the door frame: Structural Weakness.

onFailure.text: The scan finds nothing useful in the door frame.

injured.label: Injured
injured.description: A crewmember lies hurt and barely conscious.

stabilized.label: Stabilized
stabilized.description: The crewmember is stable and resting.

actions.label: Stabilize
actions.description: Treat the injuries before they get worse.

onSuccess.text: The injured crewmember says the guards came out of the room north of the hall.
The crewmember's breathing steadies. They manage a few words about the guards.

onComplication.text: Their condition worsens; treatment will be harder now.

offline.label: Offline
offline.description: A burnt-out relay feeding the damaged door's circuit.

actions.label: Restore Power
actions.description: Rebuild the relay and reroute power to the door circuit.

onSuccess.text: Power flows to the damaged door; it can now be opened normally.

onComplication.text: The relay arcs with a loud crack.

actions.label: Overload Junction
actions.description: Push the restored relay past its limits so the junction floods the hall with sparks and glare.

onSuccess.name: Overloaded Junction
onSuccess.description: Sparks and glare fill the hall (enemy ranged attacks: Difficulty +1).

onSuccess.text: The junction erupts in a shower of sparks: Overloaded Junction.

onFailure.text: The relay's safeties cut in before the junction overloads.
